basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow (Computer Science and Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the time-bound research project "Indigenous OTP PUF Technology Evaluation and Use Case Demonstration" (Project Code – R/PUD), sponsored by the Directorate of Futuristic Technology Management (DFTM), Defence Research and Development Organisation, Ministry of Defence. Consolidated compensation is upto 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, for 24 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earl

age_limit.details: The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Biology related Sciences / Master's Degree in Biological sciences / B. Pharm or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology / M. Pharm or Masters' degree in Engineering or Technology or in medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. Selected through a process described in any one of the following: (a) scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE; (b) the selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc.

how_to_apply: Apply online for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) assignment under Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/PUD/2026/101 on or before 6 December 2026.
The application fee is shown as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST.

The notice states that the application fee shall be deposited in the following bank account through RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc.: Bank Name: State Bank of India (00202); Bank Address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302; Name of Bank A/C: IIT SRIC-OM Account; Account No: 39502115210; IFSC Code: SBIN0000202; Swift Code: SBININBB339.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection process.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy)
Indigenous OTP PUF Technology Evaluation and Use Case Demonstration (Project Code – R/PUD)
Directorate of Futuristic Technology Management (DFTM), Defence Research and Development Organisation, Ministry of Defence
24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation upto 37000 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
35 years (as on last date of advertisement)
0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Biology related Sciences / Master's Degree in Biological sciences / B. Pharm or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology / M. Pharm or Masters' degree in Engineering or Technology or in medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. Selected through a process described in any one of the following: (a) scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE; (b) the selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Background in Hardware Security / Cryptography will be appreciated. A valid GATE Score is necessary. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is upto 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is described in the notice as temporary.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are there at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice lists a four years Bachelor's Degree in Biology related Sciences, a Master's Degree in Biological sciences, B. Pharm, a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology, or M. Pharm or a Master's degree in Engineering or Technology or in medicine, from a recognized University or equivalent. Selection through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or a national level examination is also required.

faq.question: Q4. Is a GATE score necessary?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says a valid GATE Score is necessary. Background in Hardware Security / Cryptography will be appreciated.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the JRF?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is upto 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the JRF assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is temporary and tied to a time-bound research project.

faq.question: Q10. Does meeting the qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum and mere possession does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
